ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic diagram of railway distribution in the Southwest-South China area of China. It can be seen that the Nanning-Kunming Railway roughly connects the vicinity of Kunming and the vicinity of Nanning, and the line passes through Yunnan, Guizhou, and western Guangxi, with the areas along the line located near the Yunnan-Guizhou Plateau and the mountainous areas of western Guangxi. Reasoning: The question stem asks about “another reason” for the high cost per unit mileage, and limits it to the characteristics of the “geological conditions” of the areas along the line, rather than simply asking about terrain undulations. The Yunnan-Guizhou-western Guangxi area through which the Nanning-Kunming Railway passes has widely distributed karst landforms, fractured strata, and many engineering geological problems, so it can be summarized as complex geological conditions.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：识别南昆铁路位于我国西南，从昆明附近通向南宁附近，沿线经过云贵高原和广西西部山地。再读取题干：问“另一原因”限定为沿线地区的“地质条件”特点，而不是地形特点。结合区域地理知识，云贵—桂西一带岩溶广布、地层破碎、工程地质问题多，因此概括为“地质条件复杂”。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是我国西南—华南一带的铁路分布示意图，可见南昆铁路大致连接昆明附近与南宁附近，线路经过云南、贵州、广西西部一带，沿线位于云贵高原及桂西山地附近。推理：题干问的是单位里程造价高的“另一原因”，并且限定为沿线地区的“地质条件”特点，而不是单纯问地形起伏。南昆铁路经过的云贵—桂西地区岩溶地貌广布，地层破碎，工程地质问题多，因此可概括为地质条件复杂。
